name: skills
description: Skills for Real Engineers. Straight from my .agents directory.
one_liner: A ready-made playbook of instructions that teaches AI coding assistants how to write, test, and ship real production code the way an experienced engineer would.
buyer: A dev-tools educator or bootcamp who already sells TypeScript/testing training and wants a packaged 'AI-agent add-on' to sell alongside their existing course.
business_use_cases: A coding bootcamp bundles the skill pack with its TypeScript course so students' AI agents write code the same way the curriculum teaches.
A freelance dev-tools consultant installs it for clients as part of a paid 'set up your team's AI coding agent properly' engagement.
An engineering manager adopts it internally to keep every developer's AI assistant producing consistent, review-ready code.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a paid 'agent onboarding' service: install and customize this and similar skill packs for a company's specific stack and conventions.
Bundle it as a premium add-on inside an existing paid newsletter/course on professional TypeScript engineering.

steal_this: Package a one-hour 'audit your team's AI agent setup' consulting session this weekend, using this repo as the reference standard you compare clients against.
